<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This file is a legitimate Electron application launcher/wrapper script (`jeancode.js`) for the jeancode-bin AUR package. It performs standard packaging tasks: resolving the application directory from command-line arguments (`--app`), environment variables (`_APPDIR`), or a fallback path (`/usr/lib/@appname@`); setting `process.resourcesPath` accordingly; forcing production environment variables when a packaged app is detected; and implementing filesystem redirection so that Electron's default `resources/` path is transparently mapped to the actual app directory. The code is clear, unobfuscated, makes no network requests, downloads no code, exfiltrates no data, and contains no eval/base64/exec or other dangerous patterns. The `@appname@` placeholder is a build-time substitution typical of Arch packaging. This is ordinary upstream/Electron packaging behavior, not a supply-chain attack.
</details>
